title: Olympus: Risk-Monotone Counterfactual Fusion for Governed Multimodal Prediction
research_question: Can normalized heterogeneous fusion with emitted counterfactual influence, disagreement-conditioned intrinsic risk, and a host-monotone governance boundary improve source-disjoint predictive quality and failure detection without weakening externally declared risk or legal-transition constraints?
scientific_objective: Test the architectural mechanism against parameter-, compute-, and information-matched alternatives on rights-reviewed, source-disjoint multimodal and temporal data.
current_hypothesis: Risk-monotone counterfactual fusion improves task quality and selective failure detection under missing or corrupted components while preserving host risk and transition invariants.
intended_contribution: A falsifiable fusion contract combining normalized heterogeneous representations, leave-one-component-out decisions, disagreement-conditioned intrinsic risk, and deterministic host-owned safety constraints.

included: six reference model families and the composed Olympus system
counterfactual fusion, risk, transition, calibration, and routing diagnostics
bounded instruction-model training as an engineering case study
reproducible software, raw artifacts, statistics, figures, and paper package
excluded_until_data_exist: clinical, legal, or operational deployment claims
fresh confirmatory conclusions from the already observed smoke test split
claims that instruction SFT validates multimodal fusion or JEPA super-resolution

development_budget.reason: The matrix is a bounded engineering audit, not an open-ended metric search.

compute_budget.abort_policy: Retain and report resource rejection, exception, or non-finite outcome; do not weaken guards.

protected_evaluation_boundary.reason: The 12-record smoke test split was inspected in earlier development runs.
protected_evaluation_boundary.allowed_use: Explicitly labeled exploratory infrastructure backtesting only.
protected_evaluation_boundary.required_for_confirmation: Acquire a new rights-reviewed aligned corpus and freeze a never-observed source-disjoint test split before confirmatory execution.

datasets.scientific_role: candidate external visual intervention and OOD benchmark; insufficient for the full aligned Olympus contract

claims.claim: Effective risk never falls below host-declared risk.
Forbidden transitions are masked and high risk forces host-allowed STOP.
Olympus fusion improves source-disjoint predictive quality.
The improved tiny SFT candidate passes an infrastructure smoke gate.
Cosine scheduling and validation-best restoration reduce observed smoke-test loss in the frozen 24-run matrix.
The tiny SFT candidates solve held-out instructions.

decisions: Do not reinterpret the 36-record instruction corpus as aligned Olympus scientific data.
Do not use exploratory backtests to authorize promotion or H1-H5 claims.
Freeze the 24-run engineering matrix before executing any new run.
Preserve every failed run and immutable artifact.
A new corpus and untouched protected test set are mandatory for confirmatory research.
The controlled synthetic v2 successor is NEGATIVE and does not close this predecessor's natural-data or JEPA questions.
The reliability-supervised v3 successor is also NEGATIVE; do not reopen it or reinterpret its synthetic evidence as natural-data or JEPA validation.
Do not extract, train on, or evaluate EditCLEVR until all four pinned payload archives and every split-referenced path pass the fail-closed validator.

The EditCLEVR admission condition was satisfied on 2026-10-11 for all five pinned archives. The owner's dataset-readiness request authorized materialization, but not evaluation, confirmatory reuse, or an Olympus capability claim.
Use the committed uv.lock as the canonical Python dependency resolution for CI and release builds; release artifacts must use the locked, non-isolated build backend.
Do not weaken the 2 GiB available-memory floor or 90 percent swap ceiling to complete a download, test, or training run.

The migrated historical O1 protocol remains PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN and UNFROZEN_DO_NOT_RUN until its exact 100-task manifest, provider/runtime identity, prompts, decoding, budgets, and authorization are frozen without altering the archived contract.

failures.result: First tiny SFT candidate failed the infrastructure smoke gate.
No rights-reviewed aligned multimodal, temporal, governance, and intrinsic-risk corpus is present; central hypotheses cannot be executed validly.
All 24 frozen backtests were rejected before training at 91.2% swap utilization; the subsequent all-failure plot path raised StatisticsError and the attempt was classified invalid.
A repository-wide test attempt retained 185 passes and three deep-Foundry setup errors when concurrent dataset acquisition raised swap to 93.9%; the resource guard was not weakened.

The first complete EditCLEVR materialization preserved exact data integrity but ended at 90.083% swap, narrowly above the 90% ceiling. The receipt is retained as a resource-policy deviation; the materializer now checks after every archive and before promotion.

The first lock-derived SBOM attempt under the temporary Python 3.14.0 environment failed when pip-audit's ensurepip subprocess received SIGABRT; the identical exported lock input later passed under Python 3.14.7 and produced the retained final SBOM.

A fresh monolithic suite passed 197 tests before the unchanged resource governor rejected the shared deep-Foundry fixture for three tests at 95.4% swap; the partial coverage failure was downstream and the attempt is retained.
A later fresh CLI demo replay was not started because preflight observed 91.11% swap, above the unchanged 90% ceiling.

history.event: Canonical state initialized from existing receipts, implementation, dataset manifest, and paper draft.
A 24-run exploratory instruction-model backtest matrix was frozen before execution.
The first execution attempt retained 24 resource-governor rejections and exposed an all-failure aggregation bug; the guard was not weakened and the bug was repaired for a new immutable run root.
The corrected frozen matrix completed 24 of 24 runs. Engineering disposition was MIXED; central Olympus hypotheses remained NOT_EVALUATED.
Exploratory evidence was locked and the arXiv manuscript source was generated from retained artifacts.

The eight-page PDF passed visual inspection, the arXiv package compiled from a clean extraction, and 181 tests plus static checks passed. Checkpoint 10 remained open because the central scientific question was not evaluated.

A separately versioned controlled synthetic successor completed 25 training runs and 75 protected evaluations with a NEGATIVE disposition; the full router tied uniform fusion on clean accuracy and underperformed it under corruption in the point estimate.
The updated ten-page manuscript and new arXiv source package preserve the negative result while the predecessor remains blocked on rights-reviewed aligned natural data and JEPA evidence.

A separately versioned reliability-supervised shrinkage successor completed 25 development fits and 75 protected evaluations with a NEGATIVE result: primary delta -0.0125, 95 percent paired-bootstrap interval [-0.028125, 0.003125], and zero invariant violations.
The five-page v3 negative-result manuscript passed full-page visual inspection and its arXiv source package clean-compiled; neither artifact was externally submitted.

A repository closure audit pinned EditCLEVR to revision 734efa9b0164ba742cd2c39b9c2945c494497c23, recorded upstream LFS hashes and license, implemented a bounded-memory fail-closed archive/split validator, and paused payload acquisition after the unchanged resource governor rejected concurrent model-test setup.

After resource admission recovered, the final current-tree Python gate passed 197 tests at 86.69 percent branch coverage; Ruff, strict MyPy across 107 source files, dependency audits, six web tests, web production build, wheel/source build, Twine metadata validation, and SBOM generation also passed within their recorded scope.

The release audit found and fixed source-distribution leakage of the 186 MB external split registry; external datasets are now excluded while the validator script remains included. No commit, push, tag, package publication, arXiv submission, deployment, or model promotion was performed.

The historical Olympus O1 preregistration was migrated from closed, unmerged VertexED PR 653 as nine byte-exact files bound to source commit bc22ecc73201659cf099a20b6d038675b7307f28 and verified SHA-256 values. Its archival synthetic contract suite passed 10 tests, but the missing task/provider/runtime/prompt freeze keeps execution unauthorized.

Resource-admitted range resumption completed all EditCLEVR archives at immutable revision 734efa9b0164ba742cd2c39b9c2945c494497c23. The strengthened five-archive validator passed 202,835 files, 20,000 unique pairs, 120,000 referenced paths, exact split-archive binding, and zero unsafe, invalid, or missing members. Archives remain unextracted and no benchmark result was generated.

A 110-package universal uv.lock was generated and wired into CI, release verification, contributor guidance, and non-isolated distribution builds to prevent dependency and build-backend resolution drift.

The admitted EditCLEVR snapshot was atomically materialized as 202,838 extracted files plus a content-bound marker. Its first receipt retained a 90.083% final-swap deviation; a hardened materializer now performs stage-wise resource checks, and a later admitted loader smoke verified all 2,000 CoGenT records plus real PNG, scene, and mask decoding.

Fresh CLI closure passed all deterministic demos, the complete Foundry registry/checkpoint/evaluation/export golden path, integrity status, and immutable 36-record dataset preparation at a unique run root. The verification bigram remains infrastructure-only and unpromoted.

Packaging was narrowed to avoid traversing the 202,838-file ignored external corpus. A clean 110-package uv environment synchronized, built locked non-isolated wheel and sdist artifacts, passed Twine and content checks, and replaced its editable install with the wheel for full-dependency import and CLI verification.

SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH was bound to the exact source commit in CI and release workflows. The normalized direct wheel and the wheel rebuilt from the clean sdist were byte-identical at SHA-256 b917c69dd0527cbc90c13ca59ca5b947c8b979cde76db0009500e27c93789cab.

Final reconciliation observed 2,955,870,208 available bytes but 92.804% swap utilization after the system swap pool contracted to 9 GiB. The unchanged resource policy stopped all further heavy local work; completed evidence was retained.

Fresh testing preserved a resource-rejected monolithic attempt, then isolated the seven deep-Foundry tests after resource recovery. All 200 unique Python tests passed across the two processes with 86.72% combined coverage; Ruff, strict MyPy across 110 files, offline uv.lock validation, git diff integrity, six web tests, both npm audits, and the production web build passed. A later demo replay was preflight-rejected at 91.11% swap before execution. Scientific and external-release boundaries remain unchanged.
